policy.storageRule: Local reviewed project intent only; no secrets, raw transcripts, public or tunnel URLs, broad project dumps, or user absolute paths.
policy.updateRule: Use explicit reviewed updates only. Memory hints are advisory and never bypass AE read tools, plan validation, mutation gates, checkpoints, idempotency, or read-back verification.

entries.title: Generated Asset Prefixes
entries.summary: Use clear generated prefixes such as Codex Test, Codex QA, or AE Agent Generated for temporary validation assets so cleanup can target only generated items.
appliesWhen: Creating temporary comps, layers, folders, or render queue items for validation.
Planning cleanup or idempotency for generated objects.
notes: Never apply generated-prefix cleanup to user-named assets.

entries.title: Protect User Project Assets
entries.summary: Treat non-generated comps, footage, folders, render queue items, and selected layers as user assets; inspect first and prefer narrow selected-target operations.
appliesWhen: The request would rename, move, replace, delete, retime, or batch-edit existing project assets.
A prompt is broad or does not clearly name generated objects.
notes: Verify targets with read tools before any mutation.

entries.title: Batch Naming Conventions
entries.summary: For broad naming work, read current names and use exact prefix, suffix, or find-replace rules; avoid guessing user naming conventions from project-wide dumps.
appliesWhen: The user asks for layer, comp, or project-item renaming.
The requested naming pattern is underspecified or affects many existing objects.
notes: Prefer explicit selected targets for rename operations.

entries.title: Deep Duplicate Fileless Source Fallback
entries.summary: When deep-duplicating precomp sources, generated solids or placeholders may have no file; reuse or reconstruct them with explicit warnings instead of failing the whole run.
appliesWhen: A selected precomp contains adjustment layers, generated solids, placeholders, or missing footage sources.
notes: Memory is advisory only and never bypasses typed read tools or mutation gates.
